how_found: 12 CMA-ES restarts (sigma 0.3 in the unit box, 15000 evaluations each, first start at sdl_dt's default layout, the rest uniform random), then Nelder-Mead polish of the 9 continuous coordinates of the 8 best with their branch flags fixed; best of all. At most 204000 evaluations in total. Best-known, not proven optimal.
note: Best-known value from a short search (12 CMA-ES restarts x 15000 evaluations, about 25 min single process). It is NOT collision-free: min clearance -25 mm (penalty 48.5 s on a 37.65 s cycle). No fully feasible layout has been found yet; a longer search may lower f_opt, which would raise every regret.
